opportunities.point: Management expects the order book to be maintained between INR600 crores and INR800 crores by the end of the year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "With that, I think we believe, with the end of the year, we may maintain between -- the order book may maintain between INR600 crores and INR800 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-10-01)

threats.point: Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 21 -> 25 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow 38 Cr (Mar 2025) -> 26 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Inventory are stretching year on year.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Management noted that price movements in CRGO steel and transformer oil can impact margins when there is a timing difference.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "These movements can impact margins, especially where there is a timing difference between increase in input costs and the corresponding adjustment under the price variation clause." (concall transcript - 2026-10-01)

threats.point: Geopolitical issues caused raw material price fluctuations during the period.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "And though there was a geopolitical issues were there due to that, the price rise of the raw materials are being absorbed because of this price variation clause, which we get from our buyers." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Sep) are still in the cycle.
